name: donut-chart
title: Donut chart
description: A donut or pie chart drawn in dither cells, with a colour and texture per slice, a spotlight and a centre that follows the pointer.

name: radar-chart
title: Radar chart
description: Series across several axes, drawn as polygons of dither cells whose density steps up ring by ring, with an axis scrub and legend spotlight.

name: gauge
title: Gauge
description: A radial gauge of dithered blocks that fill in to the value, with the reading in the middle.

name: uptime-bar
title: Uptime bar
description: A status-page row of daily dithered bars with per-day tooltips and overall uptime.

name: dot-map
title: Dot map
description: A flat world map in dithered dots with pulsing markers, dithered halos and dotted arcs.
